data.name: Saanvi
data.gender_notes: Saanvi is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Goddess Lakshmi; one who follows knowledge
data.long_meaning: Often derived from the Sanskrit sanu, 'summit, top', or linked to Saraswati/Lakshmi. Its root is Sanskrit sanu (सनु). A modern popular Indian given name. Saanvi is a Sanskrit name meaning “Goddess Lakshmi; one who follows knowledge”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Saanvi expresses “Goddess Lakshmi; one who follows knowledge”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Often derived from the Sanskrit sanu, 'summit, top', or linked to Saraswati/Lakshmi.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Saanvi total 21, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
